name: Declared Evidence Comparison (evidence-compare)
description: C02 claims-comparison demo: `evidence verify-source` produces two real saved Evidence records; the declared `evidence-compare` route reports claims_match for records of the same source and subject_match == false for a record of a foreign source — record-vs-record drift detection without a Core re-run.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C02 record-vs-record boundary end to end: produce two real records from the same source and one from a foreign source, then show the declared compare route reports claims_match for identical claims and mismatch for foreign claims.
artifact_contracts: Steps 1-3 save real mumei.verification-evidence/v1 records from `evidence verify-source`.
Step 4 runs `python -m agent evidence-compare` on the two same-source records and asserts claims_match == true.
Step 5 runs the same route on a same-source record vs the foreign-source record and asserts claims_match == false — data, not an error.

Generate evidence: produce_a.log, produce_b.log, produce_c.log, match.log, mismatch.log, evidence_a.json, evidence_b.json, evidence_c.json, match.json, mismatch.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: claims_match means only that two records carry the same bound subject and specification claims: truth, freshness and authenticity stay in checks_not_performed.
evidence-compare is the record-vs-record companion of evidence-identity-check (record vs current bytes) and verify-recheck (record vs fresh query): no Core run and no spawn.
Every step exits the pipe-and-grep form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is evidence-compare-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Produce the first saved Evidence record
steps.command: {mumei_bin} evidence verify-source {root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_compare/src/identity.mm --json --solver-timeout 5000 --solver-resource-limit 1000000 > {output_dir}/evidence_a.json 2> {output_dir}/produce_a.log; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/evidence_a.json; cat {output_dir}/produce_a.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; e=json.load(open('{output_dir}/evidence_a.json')); assert e['schema_version']=='mumei.verification-evidence/v1' and e['result']=='established', e; print('evidence A: established verification-evidence record saved')"
steps.artifact_contract: evidence_a.json binds schema mumei.verification-evidence/v1 with result established for identity.mm under the producer's declared solver budget.
steps.verifier_gate: verify-source exits 0 and writes an established verification-evidence record.

steps.name: Produce a second saved Evidence record (same source)
steps.command: {mumei_bin} evidence verify-source {root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_compare/src/identity.mm --json --solver-timeout 5000 --solver-resource-limit 1000000 > {output_dir}/evidence_b.json 2> {output_dir}/produce_b.log; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/evidence_b.json; cat {output_dir}/produce_b.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; e=json.load(open('{output_dir}/evidence_b.json')); assert e['schema_version']=='mumei.verification-evidence/v1' and e['result']=='established', e; print('evidence B: established verification-evidence record saved')"
steps.artifact_contract: evidence_b.json binds schema mumei.verification-evidence/v1 with result established for identity.mm under the producer's declared solver budget.
steps.verifier_gate: verify-source exits 0 and writes an established verification-evidence record.

steps.name: Produce a saved Evidence record for a foreign source
steps.command: {mumei_bin} evidence verify-source {root_dir}/scenarios/evidence_compare/src/other.mm --json --solver-timeout 5000 --solver-resource-limit 1000000 > {output_dir}/evidence_c.json 2> {output_dir}/produce_c.log; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/evidence_c.json; cat {output_dir}/produce_c.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; e=json.load(open('{output_dir}/evidence_c.json')); assert e['schema_version']=='mumei.verification-evidence/v1' and e['result']=='established', e; print('evidence C: established verification-evidence record saved')"
steps.artifact_contract: evidence_c.json binds schema mumei.verification-evidence/v1 with result established for other.mm under the producer's declared solver budget.
steps.verifier_gate: verify-source exits 0 and writes an established verification-evidence record.

steps.name: evidence-compare: same-source records report claims_match
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-compare --evidence-a {output_dir}/evidence_a.json --evidence-b {output_dir}/evidence_b.json --output {output_dir}/match.json > {output_dir}/match.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/match.json; cat {output_dir}/match.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/match.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.evidence-comparison/v1' and r['subject_match'] and r['specification_match'] and r['claims_match'], r; print('evidence-compare: same-source records report claims_match')"
steps.artifact_contract: match.json binds schema mumei.evidence-comparison/v1 with subject_match, specification_match and claims_match all true.
steps.verifier_gate: evidence-compare exits 0 and reports claims_match for two records of the same source.

steps.name: evidence-compare: foreign record reports claims mismatch
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent evidence-compare --evidence-a {output_dir}/evidence_a.json --evidence-b {output_dir}/evidence_c.json --output {output_dir}/mismatch.json > {output_dir}/mismatch.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/mismatch.json; cat {output_dir}/mismatch.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/mismatch.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.evidence-comparison/v1' and r['claims_match'] is False, r; print('evidence-compare: foreign record reports claims mismatch')"
steps.artifact_contract: mismatch.json binds schema mumei.evidence-comparison/v1 with claims_match == false.
steps.verifier_gate: evidence-compare exits 0 and reports claims_match == false for a foreign-source record.
